hazards.description: Trash and litter on the right-hand sidewalk create minor obstructions and tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground sidewalk

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk is very narrow and lacks any buffer from the roadway, providing minimal protection for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, running along the front of the row houses.

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalks
hazards.description: The walkways are extremely narrow, providing insufficient space for pedestrians to pass each other comfortably, especially with vehicle overhangs.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street in front of the row houses

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs despite the presence of residential and commercial land uses.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway span

hazards.name: Pedestrian in roadway
hazards.description: A pedestrian is walking in the travel lane next to parked cars instead of on the sidewalk, likely due to perceived convenience or minor obstructions.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground left

hazards.name: Faded lane markings
hazards.description: The center line markings are heavily worn, which can lead to lane drift and reduced driver awareness of the roadway center.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian-vehicle separation
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the roadway with no buffer zone or furniture zone to protect pedestrians from traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground

hazards.name: Poor Roadway Condition
hazards.description: The asphalt roadway shows signs of wear and cracking, which can be a tripping hazard if pedestrians cross mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway surface.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to physically reduce vehicle speeds along this residential corridor.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the road, which also helps to naturally slow traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a safe crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the travel lane.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a buffer zone with trees or bollards to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or mid-block points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Introduce vegetation to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting specifically for the sidewalk to improve safety and security at night.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Introduce speed humps or speed cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks to provide designated and safer crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the travel lane while improving the streetscape.

interventions.title: Waste Management Infrastructure
interventions.description: Provide designated off-sidewalk areas or enclosures for trash collection to keep the walkway clear for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.
interventions.source: NACTO Urban Street Design Guide (Street Design Elements)

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, while also helping to slow traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a safe, designated crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Dedicated Trash Management
interventions.description: Implement containerized trash storage to remove bags from the narrow pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings to designate safe crossing locations for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and personal security after dark.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with high-visibility 'continental' markings and appropriate signage to provide a safe legal crossing point.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Storage
interventions.description: Implement a program for off-sidewalk trash storage or designated enclosures to ensure the pedestrian clear zone is maintained.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Markings
interventions.description: Repaint center lines and intersection crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to improve driver compliance and awareness.
